name: tooltip
summary: Provides concise keyboard-accessible contextual help without interactive bubble content.

agent.useWhen: A small icon trigger needs concise, noninteractive contextual clarification.
agent.avoidWhen: The content needs links, controls, long-form explanation, or a touch-only disclosure. Native readiness covers literal static-page declarations, not runtime bindings or live-region replacement.

invariants: id is a stable lowercase kebab-case DOM ID reserved by derived_ids; triggerLabel and title are escaped nonblank plain text.
Optional description is plain text; bubble is noninteractive and linked to its keyboard-focusable trigger by aria-describedby.
Icon defaults to the closed help geometry catalog; caller-supplied icon names are validated against locked geometry.
Placement is top, right, bottom, or left; runtime positioning chooses collision-aware placement. Arrow defaults false.

Without JavaScript help stays visible in normal flow and the inert trigger is hidden. Enhancement adds hover/focus positioning and Escape dismissal without losing trigger focus; cleanup restores static help and releases listeners.
Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion; tooltip content never accepts raw markup or commands.
The fragment contains exactly one [[tooltip]] slot.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-tooltip-focus-ring
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls focus ring color for  tooltip.
